name: Guangdong Times Museum
known: Set up in 2003 as a branch of the Guangdong Museum of Art, co-founded by Times Property (now Times China) and that museum.
Curatorial staff fell from 18 to three, it works with several guest curators, and the Social Practice Lab and Media Lab did not return for now (The Art Newspaper, Lisa Movius, 26 March 2024).

Associate director and chief curator Nikita Yingqian Cai said the museum will pursue a "model of sustainability" and rely on a range of donors rather than one backer (The Art Newspaper, 26 March 2024).
Co-founded with the Guangdong Museum of Art, which ran it as a branch until it became independent in 2010, and set up Times Art Center Berlin in 2018.
Curatorial staff fell from 18 to three.

name: Hong Kong Museum of the War of Resistance and Coastal Defence
M+
known: Lars Nittve was inaugural director.

HSBC became M+'s first Lead Partner from 1 November 2022, covering select special exhibitions, NGO tours and family days; no amount or end date is stated, and M+ Board chair Bernard Chan called it "long-term" (M+ press release, 5 August 2022).

name: M+ Museum
known: Lars Nittve was the inaugural director and Suhanya Raffel has been director since January 2019 (Wikipedia).
The founding gift was 1,463 works by 325 artists from the Swiss collector Uli Sigg, "conservatively valued" at HK$1.3 billion (Wikipedia).
Ho Family Foundation Hong Kong (youth learning programme, Lars Nittve keynote lectures) and the De Ying Foundation (a curator of Chinese contemporary art) (M+).

name: Tai Kwun
known: Herzog & de Meuron did the masterplan, Rocco Design Architects the executive design, and Purcell the heritage conservation.

Chief Executive Carrie Lam said at the opening ceremony on 25 May 2018 that the project was "a gift from the Hong Kong Jockey Club to the people of Hong Kong", with the Club committing HK$3.8 billion against the government's original estimate of HK$1.8 billion announced in October 2007 (news.gov.hk)

name: Art Macao
known: The 2025 edition, chief curator Feng Boyi with Liu Gang and Wu Wei, ran July to October under the theme "Hey, what brings you here?": nearly 30 exhibitions at 28 venues, over 160 artists and about 5 million visits (Cultural Affairs Bureau).

name: How Art Museum
known: Founded by the hotelier-collector Zheng Hao.

On site: exhibition galleries, a collection of about 2,000 works by artists including Damien Hirst, Anish Kapoor, Yayoi Kusama, Xu Bing, Lin Tianmiao and Ai Weiwei, and a curatorial residency that houses participants at the hotel next door (The Art Newspaper; e-flux, 16 March 2018).
The museum sits in the same park as the founder's Onehome Art Hotel, and its director Yun Cheagab said of the arrangement: "What the museum shows, the hotel collects" (The Art Newspaper).
HOW Art Museum posts no annual reports, accounts, sponsor list or board; its pages name only founder Zheng Hao and director Yun Cheagab.

name: Long Museum
known: Founded by the collectors Liu Yiqian and his wife Wang Wei, who curates.
Liu Yiqian, a former taxi driver who built his fortune from share purchases in the 1990s, chairs Sunline Group and founded Guohua Life Insurance in 2004 (Wikipedia).
A private museum founded by Liu Yiqian and Wang Wei with three venues in two cities: West Bund and Pudong in Shanghai, and one in Chongqing.
Archived pages name only the founders Liu Yiqian and Wang Wei.
Founder-covered losses; large 2023 consignment.

name: Memorial of the Site of the First National Congress of the CPC
Power Station of Art
known: The museum also holds design exhibitions under the name Power Station of Design and has hosted the Emerging Curators Project since 2014.
Wikipedia lists Gong Yan as director and gives about 700,000 visitors in 2019.

name: Rockbund Art Museum
known: Its opening show was curated by Cai Guo-Qiang, and Hsiangling Lai was director at the opening (Institute of Network Cultures).
The museum's support page names Lynn and Thomas Ou as founders and ROCKBUND and Ping An as lead sponsors, with no years or amounts.

At the 2010 opening, Lovink wrote that the Rockbund Investment Corporation owns the museum and that the board of the Rockbund was its sole sponsor; director Hsiangling Lai told him the municipality had no plans to build a contemporary arts museum and wanted private developers to establish such insti
Its support page names founders Lynn and Thomas Ou and lead sponsors Rockbund and Ping An, undated.
Governed under Shanghai Civil Affairs Bureau non-profit regulations with curatorial independence.

name: Shanghai Biennale
known: Founded in 1996 by Fang Zengxian, then director of the Shanghai Art Museum, as China's first international contemporary art biennale.

name: TANK Shanghai
known: Founded by the collector Qiao Zhibing, a karaoke club owner, who planned it for more than four years and was invited to create it by the government-backed West Bund Development Group.
Its site names a four-person council led by founder Qiao Zhibing.

name: Yuz Museum
known: Founded by the Chinese-Indonesian collector Budi Tek, who opened a first Yuz Museum in Jakarta in 2006 (ArtReview) and the larger Shanghai museum on 17 May 2014 (Wikipedia).
His daughter Justine Alexandria Tek became museum director in 2022 (ArtReview).
Wu Hung chairs the academic committee (Wikipedia).
Source of the founder's wealth: Tek was president and director of the Indonesian poultry and restaurant group PT Sierad Produce Tbk, which listed in 1996 (Wikipedia).
Founded by Budi Tek in 2014; its About page presents the Yuz Foundation, set up in 2007, which also works through Yuz Museum Jakarta.
